headline: Vivartia: Sale of Evergood (Goody's, Everest, Flocafé, La Pasteria) to Prem Watsa's Recipe
summary: Vivartia Holding has signed a definitive agreement to sell 100% of Evergood, its food service business, to Canada's Recipe Unlimited Corporation. Recipe is described as a strategic investor.
why: Vivartia is a Greek food company with brands in restaurants and food service. Recipe Unlimited is a Canadian restaurant operator, so the deal is a cross-border divestment of a food service unit.
